definitions.explanation: Speaking aloud to oneself without addressing anyone, often while thinking or working.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: He talks to himself a lot.

examples.japanese: 「{困|こま}ったな」と{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}った。
examples.english: "This is a problem," I muttered to myself.

examples.japanese: {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}のつもりが、{聞|き}かれていた。
examples.english: I thought I was talking to myself, but someone heard me.

notes:
FORMATION:
{独|ひと}り (alone) + {言|ごと} (speech/saying)

KANJI VARIANTS:
・{独|ひと}り{言|ごと} - standard writing
・ひとりごと - often in hiragana
・{独言|ひとりごと} - compact form

COLLOCATIONS:
・{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}う - to talk to oneself
・{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}のように - as if talking to oneself
・ぶつぶつと{独|ひと}り{言|ごと} - mumbling to oneself

RELATED WORDS:
・{寝言|ねごと} - sleep-talking
・たわ{言|ごと} - nonsense, drivel
